findings.title: Preserve right alignment in the legacy flexbox fallback
findings.body: The new flexbox mixin explicitly falls back to `display: -webkit-box`, but that older layout model does not distribute free space to auto margins. On box-only browsers such as Android 4.3's stock browser and Safari 6, removing `float: right` and relying on `margin-left: auto` therefore leaves the navigation panel immediately after the logo/topic information instead of at the right edge. No child is given `-webkit-box-flex` to absorb the remaining space. Provide a compatible expanding spacer/item for that fallback, or retain a working non-flex layout for those browsers.
